C0853.title: RaaS and IAB Industries Combine to Lower Attack Barriers
C0853.summary: In November 2021, analysis by SecPulse highlighted that Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) had evolved into a mature business model, with developers providing ransomware tools to criminal groups on a monthly or one-time fee basis and sharing profits proportionally.
